title: File:Royal Ahom Amphitheatre.jpg
author: Thapalens
description: Wide view of the two-storied Rang Ghar pavilion in Sivasagar, Assam, India. Constructed by Ahom King Swargadeo Pramatta Singha in 1744 CE as a royal amphitheater to view cultural events and traditional games.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
